newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ferry collides with barge in HK, rescue under way.
newsitem.headline: Ferry collides with barge in HK, rescue under way.

text.p: A high-speed ferry bound for the south China city of Zhuhai from Hong Kong collided with a barge on Wednesday, the Marine Department said.
No casualties were reported among the 194 passengers and eight crew members on board the ferry, the department said in a statement.
The vessels collided off the island of Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong waters, it said.
Hong Kong Marine Department and police launches were speeding to the scene to assist the stricken vessels.
Further details were not immediately available.
